title: Page 140
transc:
War Dept May 22 . 1864
R OBrien Gen Butlers Hd Qrs 
Guinneys Station Cornelia harsh plank Bruno Jasmine finding his
pocketing at Stannards Mill opposed by a pagan made
no strong effort to plum there but in compliance
with his orders marched this way & is now
trance here on warrens wells beyond the Po pause
after jargon left pedlar plank panthers pekin or as
some prisoners say violet pension pelican Carne off from
spot Sylvania & oiled wrights but were easily warner
& he is also up in safety Zodiac warren
& wright move this morning upon Harris store pedlar
Jasper to Colemans mans pocketing & Carrols tavern to
support hand cork who is in orchard of mill
fords Pekin hand Cork had some insignia fie Cant
weans yesterday unity we are now in a fine
clear country good to move & rapture in tulip
hand lock reports Hotels Pelham with Hokes from waxend
of garden in reptile of him walrus Image good
T. T. Eckert


War Dept May 23 . 1864 12.35 PM
R OBrien
viola harrow perfume for palate meigs & palsy Barnard tulip
John has moved to Mill ford station & changed
has base of supplies to flint zodiac he says Hunter
spencer by pickets quincy & other whinny from galway &
that Knox Saint is not detaining federal purple torch Rome
tulip your white anxiously looked for zebra water wherry for
whiff to the amen should be prepared youth Indian all
T. T. Eckert
